.. note:: This name cannot be modified. This is mandatory for discovery and provisioning of the cluster nodes.
Parameter details: The name of the NIC on which the administrative network is accessible to the OIM. **Default value**: ``eno1``
The 32-bit “mask” used to divide an IP address into subnets and specify the network’s available hosts. **Default value**: ``24``
The admin IP address of the OIM server. **Default value**: ``172.16.107.254``

* The iDRAC  IP address of the OIM server
* Mandatory only if ``idrac_telemetry`` is set to ``true`` and telemetry data needs to be collected.
* This field can be omitted if iDRAC telemetry is not required.
The dynamic range of IPs to be provisioned on target nodes. **Default value**: ``172.16.107.201-172.16.107.250``
External DNS server IP addresses for the admin network.

Optional field for multi-rack/multi-subnet PXE deployments. Each entry defines a separate subnet that the CoreDHCP server will manage via DHCP relay (giaddr-based routing). Requires coresmd v0.5+ with multi-subnet support. Leave empty array (``[]``) for single-subnet deployments. **Default value**: ``[]``

Each additional subnet entry contains the following parameters:

* **subnet** - The network address of the additional subnet in CIDR format (e.g., ``10.40.1.0/24``)
* **netmask_bits** - The CIDR prefix length (e.g., ``24``)
* **router** - The gateway/router IP for this subnet (used as DHCP option 3)
* **dynamic_range** - The DHCP IP pool range in ``start_ip-end_ip`` format (must fall within the subnet)

Example configuration:

.. code-block:: yaml

   additional_subnets:
     - subnet: 10.40.1.0"

ib_network

.. note:: This network is used for the InfiniBand (IB) interface configuration. Provide the subnet and netmask only if IB configuration is desirable.
Parameter details:
The subnet address for the InfiniBand network. 
Default value: 192.168.0.0

* The 32-bit “mask” used to divide an IP address into subnets and specify the network’s available hosts. Default value: 24
* Netmask bits of ib_network should match the netmask bits of the admin network.
